mission: Make ChatGPT itself the primary Prometeo control surface while preserving deterministic, durable, cross-chat state and reducing the human's coordination burden toward zero.
human_goal: A fresh chat should need only `Prometeo`, then a short project number, to recover and continue durable project state without relying on the originating chat transcript.
current_frontier: Acceptance-test the new fresh-chat HOME selector in another conversation: send `Prometeo`, verify numbered projects appear, then select `Prometeo · continuidad entre chats` and verify it resolves project-prometeo-chat-control -> chat-native-control-plane-v1 and restores PACK + FOCUS + INDEX. After that, implement the real directed Inbox/Outbox transport and parent-child critic round trip.
implemented_this_slice: Durable PROJECT_INDEX with human-facing project menu and stable project_id identities.
Project selector protocol separating project_id, workstream_id and disposable worker_instance_id.
Fresh/unbound `Prometeo` HOME routing in p.txt, stable entry and chat bootstrap.
Bare numeric selection semantics: number -> project_id -> recovery pointers, never number as identity.
IDENTITY.json for the current project/workstream/primary worker.
PRE_RESPONSE order defined in bootstrap: IDENTITY -> EPOCH -> INBOX -> FOCUS -> PACK -> AUTHORITY -> INTERPRET.
must_preserve: Agent Network v3 independent worker-state + derived network model.
Compiled Work Packets and durable RETURN/state recovery.
No requirement for the human to manually recover context that durable state can recover.
Menu numbers are presentation aliases only; durable routing uses project_id.
important_discoveries: The custom Prometeo button/audio web UI was solving frontend problems ChatGPT already solves; it should not remain on the critical path.
Agent Network v3 already implements much of worker identity/convergence/epoch infrastructure, so the correct move is extension rather than replacement.
The missing high-leverage primitives are durable per-worker FOCUS, directed Inbox/Outbox and a PRE_RESPONSE restore hook.
A user-facing Project Registry must sit above internal workstreams so the human chooses projects, not implementation topology.
A menu number cannot be the durable identifier because menu ordering can change.
Branches/critic chats become significantly more useful when modeled as parent/child workers that publish reviews directly back to the parent.
settled_decisions: Fresh/unbound `Prometeo` renders the durable project menu; already-bound/recoverable chats continue their existing project.
Project identity is `project_id`; execution identity is `workstream_id`; chat identity is disposable `worker_instance_id`.
Use native ChatGPT voice/transcription instead of maintaining custom browser audio as required infrastructure.
Use private backend infrastructure for directed inter-chat messages; keep GitHub for durable public authority/coordination artifacts.
FOCUS is an operational map, not a chat transcript summary.
Before a material answer, restore relevant durable state before interpreting the new request.
Context loading is progressive and relevance-filtered.
Small corrections default to surgical change with preservation maps.
negative_knowledge: Do not use menu numbers as durable identity.
Do not continue investing in the floating-button web UI unless it later solves a proven gap ChatGPT cannot cover.
Do not assume a chat remembers old strategic decisions just because they appeared earlier in its transcript.
Do not make the user act as courier between parent and critic chats.
Do not globally broadcast all worker chatter.
Do not make all workers mutate one shared status object.
Do not reconstruct existing infrastructure before checking whether an owner/system already exists.
open_questions: Real directed Inbox/Outbox transport, routing indexes, acknowledgement/read-cursor semantics and retention policy.
Whether mailbox transport should extend an existing Supabase Prometeo backend owner or use a new scoped owner.
How new disposable worker_instance_id objects should be registered automatically from fresh chats when branch metadata is unavailable.
Facultad project still needs one-time durable binding to its exact workstream(s); Alumnos is registered with candidate child workstreams but may need refinement after first selection.
next_actions: Open a brand-new ChatGPT conversation and send only `Prometeo`.
Confirm HOME renders the PROJECT_INDEX menu.
Select the menu item for `Prometeo · continuidad entre chats` and confirm it restores this exact frontier without transcript context.
Then inspect existing backend owners and implement actual Inbox/Outbox transport + unread cursor.
Validate one child critic -> parent Inbox round trip with no human copy/paste.
Bind Facultad and refine Alumnos after their first successful durable resolution.
continuation_rule: A future chat must load the stable Prometeo entry. If unbound, it must render PROJECT_INDEX. Selecting project-prometeo-chat-control must load IDENTITY.json + PACK.json + FOCUS.json + INDEX.md and continue from current_frontier without asking the human to restate this conversation.
